core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Obaid corresponds to the Arabic form عُبَيْد (Arabic root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d); عُبَيْد (ʿUbayd)). Its core sense is obaid; little servant. faq.q: What is the origin of Obaid?
faq.a: Obaid is associated with Arabic. Obaid is Arabic عُبَيْد (ʿUbayd) 'little servant', the diminutive of عَبْد (ʿabd), from the root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d). The source gloss 'Servant' is broadly consistent.
Yes — the underlying form عُبَيْد is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Obaid mean in Persian?

faq.q: What are the variants of Obaid?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Obaid, obaid. Script forms are عبید, عُبَيْد, उबैद.

faq.q: Is Obaid a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
